'''Titus''' (Japanese: '''トモ''' ''Tomo'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XY125|A League of His Own!]]''.

Titus was one of the competitors who participated in the [[Lumiose Conference]]. During the opening reception, he was shown talking with [[Astrid]] and [[Remo]]. His first battle was against {{Ash}}, who was late to the battle. Titus chose {{p|Altaria}} for his first Pokémon in the three-on-three match, with Ash using {{AP|Greninja}}. Ash's Greninja eventually won after it transformed into [[Bond Phenomenon|Ash-Greninja]]. Although the rest of the battle was never shown, Ash ended up defeating Titus.

He reappeared in a flashback in ''[[XY133|Coming Apart at the Dreams!]]''.
